'''Authority Immigration Document 38 ZZ/101''' was a document issued to individuals applying for an [[Immigrant Labor Visa, Class 5]] for working entry into the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It documented the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] legal codes.
